lessons.key: ac_gap::when a spec precondition names an absence before any successful initialization test every database state that phrase admits no schema at all and schema without seed not just the most convenient one
lessons.text: When a spec precondition names an absence ("before any successful initialization"), test every database state that phrase admits - no schema at all, and schema without seed - not just the most convenient one.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when the spec requires an error response to carry named fields without fixing their wording assert each field is present and non empty and record the missing wording as a spec precision gap
lessons.text: When the spec requires an error response to carry named fields without fixing their wording, assert each field is present and non-empty and record the missing wording as a spec-precision gap.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::name the exact http status code in the spec for every refusal path when the spec only says explicit error record the chosen status as a spec precision gap instead of passing it silently
lessons.text: Name the exact HTTP status code in the spec for every refusal path; when the spec only says "explicit error", record the chosen status as a spec-precision gap instead of passing it silently.

lessons.key: spec_deviation::duckdb checks foreign keys immediately and cannot defer them within a transaction so a schema needing single transaction delete and reinsert must declare relationships as documented logical foreign keys instead of references
lessons.text: DuckDB checks foreign keys immediately and cannot defer them within a transaction, so a schema needing single-transaction delete-and-reinsert must declare relationships as documented logical foreign keys instead of REFERENCES.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when a spec sets a numeric latency budget e g p95 ns add a timing assertion measured elapsed time against the threshold in addition to structural evidence like no external i o called structural evidence alone leaves the numeric bound spec unverified
lessons.text: When a spec sets a numeric latency budget (e.g. p95 <= Ns), add a timing assertion (measured elapsed time against the threshold) in addition to structural evidence like 'no external I/O called' -- structural evidence alone leaves the numeric bound spec-unverified.
evidence: PRONT-03 (validation.md P1: Ver a prontidao consolidada AC3) (backend/prontidao)

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when a spec requires a real browser behavior jsdom cannot simulate e g 200 zoom real layout measurement flag it explicitly as needing manual uat verification in the spec or tasks file instead of leaving it silently uncovered by the automated suite
lessons.text: When a spec requires a real-browser behavior jsdom cannot simulate (e.g. 200% zoom, real layout/measurement), flag it explicitly as needing manual/UAT verification in the spec or tasks file instead of leaving it silently uncovered by the automated suite.
evidence: PRONT-13 (validation.md P2: Operar a superficie por teclado e em zoom 200% AC2) (frontend/accessibility)

lessons.key: ac_gap::when a spec defines a literal fixed banner label string assert the exact combined text in a test not just that its component substrings are each present somewhere in the dom
lessons.text: When a spec defines a literal fixed banner/label string, assert the exact combined text in a test, not just that its component substrings are each present somewhere in the DOM.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when a spec defines a precise css visual value e g an exact focus outline width in pixels add a computed style assertion or explicitly document it as a uat only manual check instead of leaving it silently unasserted
lessons.text: When a spec defines a precise CSS visual value (e.g. an exact focus-outline width in pixels), add a computed-style assertion or explicitly document it as a UAT-only manual check instead of leaving it silently unasserted.
